title: Set-Reset Flip-Flop
text: Set-reset flip-flop or bistable multivibrator, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Priority when undefined state} sets the state priority and {Initial condition for Q state} sets the initial value of the output Q. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition for Q state
params.values: Initial value of the output Q 0 (default) | 1
